diagnostics.message: This project contains TurboWarp custom extension blocks
details: The extension JS is embedded in project.json.extensionURLs as a data: URL; TurboWarp loads it automatically.
Custom extension projects cannot be uploaded to the official Scratch website.
Sandboxed extension calls cost at least one VM frame each.

notes: Extension JS is embedded in project.json.extensionURLs as a data: URL; TurboWarp loads it automatically.
Custom extension projects cannot be uploaded to the official Scratch website.
TurboWarp Packager always runs extensions without the sandbox.
Sandboxed extension calls cost at least one VM frame each.

documentedDifferences: operator_equals compares numerically and case-insensitively, not with JavaScript ===
operator_mod returns a divisor-signed remainder, unlike the JavaScript % operator
Cast.toNumber maps NaN to 0 and accepts numeric strings
Infinity and NaN are rejected by the frontend as unstable Scratch variable values
